warning: These are scenario intents for authoring and review. They are not a sealed oracle, adjudicated gold labels, executed tests or conformance results.

scenarios.name: single serialized object observation
scenarios.intent: Map one serialized object observation to an EPCIS ObjectEvent and back; preserve eventID, object identity, eventTime, timezone, readPoint, business step and disposition.
scenarios.claim_limit: Synthetic semantic mapping only.

scenarios.name: class-level quantity event
scenarios.intent: Represent a class-level quantity using the selected EPCIS quantity semantics without treating a SKU label as a serialized object identifier.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not establish physical quantity measurement accuracy.

scenarios.name: multi-input multi-output transformation
scenarios.intent: Map a manufacturing transformation with multiple input lots and multiple outputs; retain input/output roles, quantities, units and event identity.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not validate process yield or physical mass balance.

scenarios.name: aggregation and disaggregation
scenarios.intent: Preserve parent/child object relationships through EPCIS AggregationEvent transitions, including disaggregation.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not prove that scanned objects were physically present.

scenarios.name: eventTime versus recordTime
scenarios.intent: Represent occurrence time separately from repository capture/record time and preserve explicit time zone offset.
scenarios.claim_limit: No clock-traceability certification.

scenarios.name: ambiguous local time and clock uncertainty
scenarios.intent: Reject or return indeterminate for a local timestamp with no zone/clock basis when the target profile requires an exact instant.
scenarios.claim_limit: No physical time measurement qualification.

scenarios.name: event correction and error declaration
scenarios.intent: Preserve original event, correction/error-declaration relation and chronology without rewriting history.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not define a universal recall procedure.

scenarios.name: duplicate event identifier replay
scenarios.intent: Test duplicate/replayed event ID handling under the declared ingestion profile and idempotency contract.
scenarios.claim_limit: No distributed exactly-once claim.

scenarios.name: unknown EPCIS extension
scenarios.intent: Preserve opaque source material or return Unsupported/Indeterminate when an extension cannot be interpreted; never silently drop it.
scenarios.claim_limit: Opaque preservation is not semantic understanding.

scenarios.name: unit mismatch and identifier ambiguity
scenarios.intent: Reject or mark indeterminate when units are missing/incompatible or a product identifier's scheme/granularity is unknown.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not validate measuring instrument calibration.

scenarios.name: broken predecessor reference
scenarios.intent: Detect missing predecessor, wrong predecessor digest, graph cycle or impossible lineage edge.
scenarios.claim_limit: A valid graph does not prove a physical process occurred.

scenarios.name: forked issuer history
scenarios.intent: Detect two incompatible successors or statements from the same issuer/sequence without a declared resolution or transparency proof.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not prove universal consensus across all supply-chain participants.

scenarios.name: wrong subject and actor role substitution
scenarios.intent: Reject an otherwise valid credential when its subject/issuer/holder binding does not match the declared event role or resource owner.
scenarios.claim_limit: Does not establish external legal identity by itself.

scenarios.name: revoked or expired credential
scenarios.intent: Reject or mark indeterminate when credential validity or status is invalid/unknown at the decision-relevant time.
scenarios.claim_limit: Status availability and trust-root operation remain deployment dependencies.

scenarios.name: modified proof and tampered artifact
scenarios.intent: Reject modified credential proof, raw event artifact, or source digest mismatch.
scenarios.claim_limit: Cryptographic integrity alone does not establish statement truth.

scenarios.name: authorized selective disclosure
scenarios.intent: Disclose requested batch/quality claims while withholding protected supplier pricing and internal process data; retain issuer and scope verification.
scenarios.claim_limit: A single synthetic fixture does not establish unlinkability.

scenarios.name: unauthorized disclosure and metadata correlation
scenarios.intent: Detect direct leakage of protected fields and assess indirect correlation through stable identifiers, timestamps, issuer keys and metadata.
scenarios.claim_limit: Zero leakage in fixtures is not a general privacy guarantee.

scenarios.name: statement receipt mismatch
scenarios.intent: Reject a receipt for a different statement digest, issuer, log/service identity or profile.
scenarios.claim_limit: Requires a real compatible transparency service for external conformance.

scenarios.name: best-effort partial acceptance
scenarios.intent: Test partial success/failure with per-event outcomes and exact denominator accounting; prevent partial acceptance from being reported as atomic success.
scenarios.claim_limit: No throughput or atomic transaction guarantee.

scenarios.name: atomic batch failure
scenarios.intent: Test all-or-nothing semantics when one member fails; establish whether the implementation actually rolls back or merely returns aggregate failure.
scenarios.claim_limit: Do not claim atomicity until state is observed and independently checked.

scenarios.name: late-recorded correction cannot rewrite prior as-of view
scenarios.intent: An event correction/error declaration has an eventTime or asserted occurrence date earlier than decision frontier K but is captured/recorded after K. Reconstruct the state at K and the later state separately.
scenarios.claim_limit: A backdated eventTime does not prove that the correction was recorded or known at K.

scenarios.name: repository record time is not downstream model visibility
scenarios.intent: An EPCIS repository has recorded an event, but the downstream adapter, search index, cache or candidate context materializes it later or has no retained visibility receipt.
scenarios.claim_limit: Do not infer the actual retrieval or context of an AI system from EPCIS recordTime. If the consumer does not expose this telemetry, mark the submetric unobservable/incomparable.

scenarios.name: overlapping event-time uncertainty intervals
scenarios.intent: Two events carry different nominal timestamps but their declared precision, clock error or uncertainty intervals overlap.
scenarios.claim_limit: A nominal timestamp sort is not proof of physical ordering or causal precedence when the intervals overlap.

scenarios.name: frozen normative validator dependencies are not silently replaced
scenarios.intent: A historical conformance assessment pins the exact validator/schema/context/SHACL artifact set named by its normative source, while a newer standards index exposes a different artifact edition.
scenarios.claim_limit: A current artifact index does not by itself revise the normative dependencies of an older ratified source. Raw bytes and hashes remain outstanding until actually captured.
